doc: A boundary's rim (design/boundary.md): the hull resolved into a closed loop of cells, and the line the world beyond grows from, sampled every metre counterclockwise as seen from above, each sample with its height, outward direction, how much of each edge it is (blended along the rim), and its rise.

fields.name: cells
fields.doc: The resolved hull's cells, as q, r pairs, in order counterclockwise as seen from above (gaps filled, duplicates dropped).

fields.name: cell_edges
fields.doc: Each resolved cell's edge (1 ledge to 7 marsh; never auto).

fields.name: cell_heights
fields.doc: Each resolved cell's ground height, metres.

fields.name: points
fields.doc: The rim's samples, metres: x, the ground height, z, about 1 m apart along the smoothed line through the cells' centres.

fields.name: weights
fields.doc: Each sample's share of each edge, 7 per sample (ledge, ridge, mountain, forest, jungle, sea, marsh), summing to 1.

fields.name: opening_points
fields.doc: Where roads and rivers cross the rim, metres.

fields.name: opening_kinds
fields.doc: Each opening's kind: 0 road, 1 lane, 2 river in, 3 river out.

fields.name: centre
fields.doc: The middle of the playable region (the rim's centroid), metres.

fields.name: extent
fields.doc: The farthest rim sample from the centre, metres.
